name: of_comp_isClosedImmersion
statement: Scheme} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion g] [IsClosedImmersion (f ≫ g)] : IsClosedImmersion f where isClosedEmbedding

name: isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot
statement: Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} [IsClosedImmersion f] : IsIso f ↔ f.ker = ⊥
